python3 << 'EOF'
import math

# Data
months = [1, 2, 3]  # Jan, Feb, Mar
nominal = [284, 295, 375]  # millions

# CPI-U values (1982-84=100)
cpi = [37.900, 38.100, 38.300]

# March 1970 CPI
cpi_march = 38.300

# Convert to real March 1970 dollars
real = [n * (cpi_march / c) for n, c in zip(nominal, cpi)]

print("Nominal redemptions (millions):", nominal)
print("CPI-U:", cpi)
print("Real redemptions in March 1970 dollars (millions):", real)

# Linear regression
x = months
y = real

n = len(x)
sum_x = sum(x)
sum_y = sum(y)
sum_xy = sum(xi * yi for xi, yi in zip(x, y))
sum_x2 = sum(xi ** 2 for xi in x)

# Calculate slope and intercept
slope = (n * sum_xy - sum_x * sum_y) / (n * sum_x2 - sum_x ** 2)
intercept = (sum_y - slope * sum_x) / n

print(f"\nLinear Regression:")
print(f"Slope: {slope}")
print(f"Intercept: {intercept}")

# Round to nearest hundredths
slope_rounded = round(slope, 2)
intercept_rounded = round(intercept, 2)

print(f"\nRounded:")
print(f"Slope: {slope_rounded}")
print(f"Intercept: {intercept_rounded}")

# Output format
print(f"\nAnswer: [{slope_rounded}, {intercept_rounded}]")
EOF
